description: This file defines the JwtIssuerOptions class, which encapsulates configuration options for JWT token issuance, including claims like issuer, subject, audience, expiration, and signing credentials.

classes.name: JwtIssuerOptions
classes.description: A class representing configurable options for issuing JWT tokens, including claims and signing credentials.

methods.name: JtiGenerator
methods.description: A property returning a function that generates a unique JWT ID (jti) as a GUID string.

methods.name: Expiration
methods.description: A property that computes the expiration time of the JWT based on the issued time and valid duration.

methods.name: NotBefore
methods.description: A property that indicates the 'not before' time for the token, defaulting to current UTC time.

methods.name: IssuedAt
methods.description: A property that indicates the token issuance time, defaulting to current UTC time.
